prelabel_attestation.scope: repository-internal Git and SHA-256 evidence for an honest owner; not proof against owner-controlled history rewriting

margin_rationale: +0.05 degrees C was fixed before confirmation outcomes as a strict numerical ceiling on allowable degradation in the station-median RMSE difference. It is not derived from sensor precision, biological response, water-quality regulation, or a stakeholder utility function, and therefore carries no ecological or regulatory importance claim.
wording_limit: H2 may say only that the result satisfies the predeclared +0.05 C numerical non-inferiority bound; it may not say equivalent, parity, equally good, ecologically negligible, or regulatorily acceptable
